label: Organize research library
description: List paper folders and assignments, create a named folder, or move a paper into a folder. Use a null folder_id with move_paper to return a paper to the default Papers group.

parameter_descriptions.action: Use list to inspect current organization, create_folder to add one folder, or move_paper to assign a paper.
parameter_descriptions.folder_name: The new folder name for create_folder; otherwise null.
parameter_descriptions.document_id: The local paper ID for move_paper; otherwise null.
parameter_descriptions.folder_id: The destination folder ID for move_paper, or null to use the default Papers group.
